<!DOCTYPE html>

<title>Miss Jasmine Bailey — Native English Teacher</title>
<meta name="description" content="Jasmine P.R. Bailey — Primary Native English Teacher (EDB PNET) in Hong Kong. Teaching philosophy, experience, professional development, lesson portfolio and testimonials.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

<style>
/* ============================================================
   MISS JASMINE BAILEY — portfolio site
   Style: Slidesgo "Pastel Watercolor Brushstrokes" —
   white paper, blush brushstrokes, sage leaves, gold speckles.
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --paper:#FFFFFF;
  --ink:#3F3B37;
  --ink-soft:#6E6862;
  --rose:#F0BCC8;
  --rose-deep:#E39AAE;
  --rose-pale:#FBEBEF;
  --sage:#A3B78D;
  --sage-deep:#748C5C;
  --sage-ink:#5A7145;
  --sage-pale:#EEF3E6;
  --gold:#D9A845;
  --gold-pale:#F6E7C4;
  --img-stroke:url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  --img-strokesm:url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  --img-leaf1:url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  --img-leaf2:url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  --img-speckle:url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  --img-washblob:url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  --line:rgba(63,59,55,.14);
  --shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(63,59,55,.09);
  --r:16px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:'Fira Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;
  font-size:1rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--paper);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:var(--sage-ink)}
a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:0;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:.6em 1em;z-index:99}
.skip:focus{left:12px;top:12px}
.defs{position:absolute;width:0;height:0;overflow:hidden}

/* ---------- typography ---------- */
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-weight:400;line-height:1.15;color:var(--ink)}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,6vw,4.1rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.045em;text-transform:uppercase}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.6vw,2.5rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}
h3{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4em}
.eyebrow{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--sage-ink);margin-bottom:.6em}
.lead{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2.2vw,1.4rem);color:var(--ink-soft);margin:1em 0 1.2em}
.small{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* ---------- painted title band ---------- */
.wash{position:relative;display:inline-block;z-index:0;padding:.2em .55em}
.wash::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-5%;right:-5%;top:-18%;bottom:-14%;z-index:-1;background:var(--img-stroke) 50% 55%/100% 100% no-repeat;pointer-events:none}

/* ---------- header / nav ---------- */
.top{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.top-in{max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto;padding:.7rem 1.2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
.brand svg{width:34px;height:34px;flex:none}
.brand-name{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.12rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.menu-btn{margin-left:auto;display:none;background:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:.45rem .7rem;font:700 .9rem 'Fira Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
nav#site-nav{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:.2rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
nav#site-nav a{
  position:relative;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink-soft);
  font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;padding:.5rem .75rem;border-radius:10px;
}
nav#site-nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
nav#site-nav a.active{color:var(--ink)}
nav#site-nav a.active::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:.5rem;right:.5rem;bottom:.05rem;height:13px;z-index:-1;
  background:var(--img-strokesm) 50% 50%/100% 100% no-repeat;opacity:.9;transform:rotate(-1.2deg);
}
@media (max-width:880px){
  .menu-btn{display:block}
  nav#site-nav{display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex-direction:column;padding:.6rem 1rem 1rem}
  nav#site-nav.open{display:flex}
  nav#site-nav a{padding:.7rem .5rem;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
}

/* ---------- layout ---------- */
main{max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.2rem}
.page{display:none;padding:3.2rem 0 4.5rem}
.page.active{display:block;animation:fadeUp .55s ease both}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.sec-head{margin-bottom:2.2rem;position:relative}
.sec-head .speck{position:absolute;right:0;top:-1.7rem;width:122px;height:62px;opacity:.95;background:var(--img-speckle) center/contain no-repeat}
.rule{border:none;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);margin:3rem 0}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:3rem;align-items:center;position:relative}
.hero-art{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.hero-wash{position:absolute;inset:-15% -13%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:var(--img-washblob) 50% 46%/contain no-repeat}
.photo{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(330px,80%);user-select:none}
.photo img{
  width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;
}
.monogram{
  width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--rose-pale),var(--sage-pale));
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:5rem;color:var(--rose-deep);
  letter-spacing:.06em;
}
.photo .sprig-tr{position:absolute;top:-72px;right:-58px;width:150px;height:196px;transform:rotate(16deg);background:var(--img-leaf2) center/contain no-repeat}
.photo .speck-bl{position:absolute;bottom:-16px;left:-48px;width:130px;height:68px;background:var(--img-speckle) center/contain no-repeat}
.btn-row{display:flex;gap:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:1.4rem 0 0}
.btn{
  display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;font-size:.95rem;
  padding:.78em 1.5em;border-radius:999px;background:var(--sage-ink);color:#fff;
  border:2px solid var(--sage-ink);transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s ease;
}
.btn:hover{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--rose-pale);transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* ---------- stats ---------- */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1rem;margin:3rem 0 0}
.stat{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:1.1rem 1.2rem;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.stat b{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:700;display:block;line-height:1.1}
.stat span{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600}
.stat:nth-child(1) b{color:var(--rose-deep)}
.stat:nth-child(2) b{color:var(--sage-deep)}
.stat:nth-child(3) b{color:var(--gold)}
.stat:nth-child(4) b{color:var(--rose-deep)}

/* ---------- cards & grids ---------- */
.card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:1.4rem 1.5rem}
.grid{display:grid;gap:1.1rem}
.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.tint-rose{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--rose-pale),#fff 55%)}
.tint-sage{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--sage-pale),#fff 55%)}
.tint-gold{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-pale),#fff 60%)}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sage-ink);background:var(--sage-pale);border-radius:999px;padding:.25em .8em;margin-bottom:.6em}
.tag.rose{color:#B4536F;background:var(--rose-pale)}
.tag.gold{color:#8A6A1F;background:var(--gold-pale)}

/* key info */
.kinfo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.35rem 2rem;margin-top:.4rem}
.kinfo div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);padding:.5rem 0;font-size:.95rem}
.kinfo dt{font-weight:700}
.kinfo dd{color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:right}
.contact-chips{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1.1rem}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.45em;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:.42em 1em;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;background:#fff;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
.chip::before{content:"";width:.55em;height:.55em;border-radius:60% 40% 55% 45%;background:var(--gold);flex:none}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--sage-deep)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem}

/* explore */
.explore{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:1rem;margin-top:1.2rem}
.explore a{
  text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);
  padding:1.1rem 1rem;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .15s ease,border-color .15s ease;
}
.explore a:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--rose-deep)}
.explore b{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.02rem;display:block;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:.3em}
.explore span{font-size:.83rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.explore .go{display:block;margin-top:.7em;font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--sage-ink)}

/* ---------- philosophy ---------- */
.pull{
  position:relative;font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.8vw,1.8rem);line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink);
  max-width:44ch;margin:0 0 2.2rem;padding-left:1.2rem;border-left:5px solid var(--rose);
}
.pillars{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.pillars .card p{font-size:.94rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
details.full{margin-top:2.2rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
details.full summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;padding:1.1rem 1.5rem;list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem}
details.full summary::before{content:"+";font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--rose-deep);line-height:1}
details.full[open] summary::before{content:"–"}
details.full .inner{padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
details.full .inner p{margin-bottom:1em}

/* ---------- timeline ---------- */
.tl{position:relative;margin:1rem 0 0;padding-left:1.9rem;border-left:3px solid var(--sage-pale)}
.tl-item{position:relative;padding:0 0 2.4rem 0}
.tl-item:last-child{padding-bottom:.5rem}
.tl-item::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:-2.55rem;top:.35rem;width:1.05rem;height:1.05rem;
  background:var(--rose-deep);border-radius:62% 38% 55% 45%/55% 45% 62% 38%;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--rose-pale);
}
.tl-item h3{margin-bottom:.1em}
.tl-meta{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--sage-ink);margin-bottom:.7em}
.tl-item ul{list-style:none;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.96rem}
.tl-item li{position:relative;padding-left:1.3em;margin-bottom:.45em}
.tl-item li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:.1em;top:.62em;width:.5em;height:.5em;background:var(--sage);border-radius:60% 40% 50% 50%}

/* education */
.edu .card h3{font-size:1.08rem}
.edu .card p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* ---------- development ---------- */
.award-list{list-style:none;margin-top:.5rem}
.award-list li{
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;
  border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);padding:.85rem .2rem;
}
.award-list b{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:600}
.award-list .place{margin-left:auto;font-weight:800;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8A6A1F;background:var(--gold-pale);border-radius:999px;padding:.25em .9em;white-space:nowrap}
.award-list .place.bronze{color:#8A5A3C;background:#F3E2D3}
.award-list .place.comm{color:var(--sage-ink);background:var(--sage-pale)}
.award-list .when{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ink-soft);white-space:nowrap}
.dev-list{list-style:none;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.dev-list li{position:relative;padding-left:1.4em;margin-bottom:.6em}
.dev-list li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:.1em;top:.6em;width:.55em;height:.55em;background:var(--gold);border-radius:60% 40% 50% 50%}

/* ---------- portfolio ---------- */
.curr .card{padding:1.15rem 1.3rem}
.curr .card h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:.15em}
.curr .card span{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--rose-deep);letter-spacing:.05em}
.ph-card{
  border:2px dashed var(--rose-deep);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--rose-pale);
  padding:1.4rem 1.5rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.94rem;
}
.ph-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#B4536F;border:1px solid var(--rose-deep);border-radius:999px;padding:.2em .8em;margin-bottom:.7em;background:#fff}

/* ---------- footer ---------- */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:2rem;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--sage-pale))}
.foot-in{max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto;padding:2.6rem 1.2rem 2.2rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:2rem;align-items:start}
.foot-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.foot-brand svg{width:38px;height:38px}
.foot-brand b{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.25rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.foot-right{text-align:right;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.foot-right a{display:block;margin-bottom:.3em}
.credit{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:1.1rem;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-soft);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* ---------- responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width:960px){
  .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2.4rem}
  .hero-art{order:-1}
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .g3,.pillars{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .explore{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  .g2,.g3,.pillars,.explore{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .kinfo{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .foot-in{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .foot-right{text-align:left}
  .sec-head .speck{display:none}
}
@media print{
  .top,.btn-row,.skip{display:none}
  .page{padding:1rem 0}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
  .rv{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
}
footer{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.foot-leaf{position:absolute;right:1.2%;bottom:3%;width:84px;height:220px;background:var(--img-leaf1) center/contain no-repeat;opacity:.4;transform:rotate(15deg);pointer-events:none}
</style>
</head>

<!-- ===== shared watercolor art: filters, leaf sprig, speckles, photo blob ===== -->
<svg class="defs" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <filter id="wcA" x="-25%" y="-45%" width="150%" height="190%">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.012 0.028" numOctaves="3" seed="8" result="n"/>
      <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="n" scale="42"/>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="0.6"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="wcB" x="-25%" y="-25%" width="150%" height="150%">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.02" numOctaves="3" seed="21" result="n"/>
      <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="n" scale="26"/>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="0.5"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="wcC" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.045" numOctaves="2" seed="4" result="n"/>
      <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="n" scale="10"/>
    </filter>
    <!-- painted apple — a nod to the logo on Miss Bailey's CV -->
    <symbol id="apple" viewBox="0 0 64 64">
      <path d="M32 21c-7-6.5-19-3.5-21.2 7.5C8.5 41 18.8 52.5 26 55.4c3 1.2 4.2 1.2 6 .1 1.8 1.1 3 1.1 6-.1 7.2-2.9 17.5-14.4 15.2-26.9C51 17.5 39 14.5 32 21z" fill="var(--rose-deep)"/>
      <path d="M33.5 19.5c.2-5.4 3.4-9.2 8.6-10.4-.8 5.4-3.5 9.4-8.6 10.4z" fill="var(--sage-deep)"/>
      <rect x="31" y="11.5" width="2.6" height="8.5" rx="1.3" fill="var(--ink)"/>
    </symbol>
  </defs>
</svg>

<header class="top">
  <div class="top-in">
    <a class="brand" href="#home" aria-label="Miss Jasmine Bailey — home">
      <svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#apple"/></svg>
      <span class="brand-name">Jasmine P.R. Bailey</span>
    </a>
    <button class="menu-btn" id="menuBtn" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="site-nav">Menu</button>
    <nav id="site-nav" aria-label="Main">
      <a data-nav href="#home">Home</a>

      <a data-nav href="#lesson-portfolio">Lesson Portfolio</a>

  </div>
</header>

<noscript><style>.page{display:block!important}</style></noscript>

<main id="main">

<!-- ================= HOME ================= -->
<section class="page" id="page-home" data-title="Home">
  <div class="hero">
    <div>
      <p class="eyebrow">Native English Teacher · Kowloon, Hong Kong</p>
      <h1 class="wash wash-rose"><span>Jasmine P.R. Bailey</span></h1>
      <p class="lead">Building confidence, fluency and a love for learning in every primary classroom.</p>
      <p>I'm a Primary Native English Teacher (EDB PNET) with 8 years on the Primary NET Scheme and over 14 years' experience with learners aged 3–18. My teaching is supported by a background in Psychology and Special Educational Needs, and I'm skilled in implementing both EDB and school-based curricula across Key Stages 1 and 2 — creating varied, educational and enjoyable activities for Primary 1–6.</p>
      <div class="btn-row">
        <a class="btn" href="#teaching-philosophy">My teaching philosophy</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="#lesson-portfolio">View lesson portfolio</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-art">
      <span class="hero-wash" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <div class="photo">
        <!-- Embedded headshot (base64). To change the photo, replace the src below. -->
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Jasmine P.R. Bailey" draggable="false"
             onerror="this.remove();document.getElementById('mono').hidden=false;">
        <div class="monogram" id="mono" hidden aria-hidden="true">JB</div>
        <span class="sprig-tr" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="speck-bl" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="stats">
    <div class="stat rv"><b>8</b><span>years as an EDB PNET on the Primary NET Scheme</span></div>
    <div class="stat rv"><b>14+</b><span>years' experience with learners aged 3–18</span></div>
    <div class="stat rv"><b>P1–6</b><span>EDB &amp; school-based curricula, Key Stages 1 &amp; 2</span></div>
    <div class="stat rv"><b>4</b><span>languages — English, Hindi, French &amp; Spanish</span></div>
  </div>

  <hr class="rule">

  <div class="grid g2">
    <div class="card tint-rose rv">
      <span class="tag rose">Key Information</span>
      <dl class="kinfo">
        <div><dt>Registered Teacher</dt><dd></dd></div>
        <div><dt>PNET Candidate</dt><dd></dd></div>
        <div><dt>BLNST</dt><dd>Pass (Jun 2024)</dd></div>
        <div><dt>SCRC</dt><dd>Valid until Mar 2029</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Child Protection Course</dt><dd>Completed 2025</dd></div>
        <div><dt>IELTS</dt><dd>In progress</dd></div>
        <div><dt>HK Permanent Resident</dt><dd>Yes</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Location</dt><dd>Kowloon, Hong Kong</dd></div>

<!-- ================= TEACHING PHILOSOPHY ================= -->
<section class="page" id="page-teaching-philosophy" data-title="Teaching Philosophy">
  <div class="sec-head">
    <p class="eyebrow">Guided by the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP)</p>
    <h2 class="wash wash-rose"><span>Teaching Philosophy</span></h2>
    <span class="speck" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  </div>

  <blockquote class="pull rv">"Learning a new language should be enriching, rewarding and — most importantly — enjoyable for each and every child."</blockquote>

  <p class="rv" style="max-width:70ch;margin-bottom:2rem">My philosophy is simple: create a supportive, engaging and inclusive environment where students develop their English through meaningful inquiry. Five ideas guide everything I plan and teach.</p>

  <div class="grid pillars">
    <div class="card tint-rose rv">
      <h3>Student-centred learning</h3>
      <p>Every learner brings different backgrounds, strengths and support needs. I differentiate through hands-on activities, interactive games, multimedia, cooperative learning, small-group instruction and one-on-one support.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card tint-sage rv">
      <h3>Authentic communication</h3>
      <p>Language grows through real opportunities to communicate, reflect and connect — so my lessons build in frequent speaking, listening, reading and writing through pair and group work, discussions and student presentations.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card tint-gold rv">
      <h3>Meaningful inquiry</h3>
      <p>Age-appropriate, content-rich topics connect to students' lives and interests, so language becomes a tool for thinking, expressing and making sense of the world — and learners develop genuine ownership and motivation.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card tint-sage rv">
      <h3>A safe, caring community</h3>
      <p>When students feel valued, respected and accepted, they take risks, try new strategies and persevere. I aim to be patient, approachable and committed to strong relationships in a classroom where diversity is celebrated.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card tint-rose rv">
      <h3>Confidence &amp; horizons</h3>
      <p>Ultimately, learning English should transform students' learning experiences — building the language, confidence and cultural awareness they need to succeed in and beyond the classroom.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <details class="full rv">
    <summary>Read my full teaching philosophy</summary>
    <div class="inner">
      <p>My teaching philosophy is guided by the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP): creating a supportive, engaging, and inclusive learning environment where students can develop their English language skills through meaningful inquiry. I believe learning a new language should be enriching, rewarding, and most importantly, enjoyable for each and every child.</p>
      <p>At the core of my approach is student-centred learning. In the PYP, I value students' individuality, recognising that learners bring different backgrounds, experiences, strengths, and support needs to the classroom. I therefore differentiate instruction and use a range of strategies to reach all learners. These include hands-on activities, interactive games, multimedia, cooperative learning, small-group instruction, and one-on-one support as needed.</p>
      <p>I believe that language learning is most effective when students have authentic opportunities to communicate, reflect, and connect. I deliberately plan for frequent practice in speaking, listening, reading, and writing, so students can grow in confidence and in fluency. In line with PYP learning goals, my lessons include regular pair and group work, class discussions, and student presentations. I also encourage students to share their ideas, questions, and perspectives, helping our classroom become a place where diversity is celebrated and understanding is built.</p>
      <p>Alongside language development, I focus on nurturing students' overall cognitive, social, and emotional growth. I use age-appropriate, content-rich inquiry topics that connect to students' lives and interests. By engaging with concepts in relevant, real-world contexts, students can see language as a powerful tool for thinking, expressing themselves, and making sense of the world. I firmly believe that when students are able to connect learning to who they are and what they care about, they develop a genuine sense of ownership and motivation.</p>
      <p>In every PYP classroom, community matters. I work to create a safe, caring, and inclusive space where students feel valued, respected, and accepted. I aim to be patient, approachable, and committed to building strong relationships. When learners feel secure, they are more willing to take risks, try new strategies, and persevere through challenges.</p>
      <p>Ultimately, my teaching philosophy is shaped by the belief that learning English should transform students' learning experiences and broaden their horizons. Through dynamic, inquiry-driven, student-centred teaching that is aligned with the IB PYP, I am dedicated to supporting primary ESL learners to develop the language, confidence, and cultural awareness they need to succeed in and beyond the classroom!</p>
    </div>
  </details>
</section>

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  var pages = document.querySelectorAll('.page');
  var links = document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]');
  var nav = document.getElementById('site-nav');
  var btn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');

  var io = ('IntersectionObserver' in window) ? new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
    });
  }, {threshold:0.12}) : null;

  function go(){
    var slug = (location.hash || '#home').slice(1);
    var target = document.getElementById('page-' + slug);
    if(!target){ slug = 'home'; target = document.getElementById('page-home'); }
    pages.forEach(function(p){ p.classList.toggle('active', p === target); });
    links.forEach(function(a){
      var on = a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + slug;
      a.classList.toggle('active', on);
      if(on){ a.setAttribute('aria-current','page'); } else { a.removeAttribute('aria-current'); }
    });
    document.title = target.getAttribute('data-title').replace('&amp;','&') + ' — Miss Jasmine Bailey';
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
    nav.classList.remove('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    var toReveal = target.querySelectorAll('.rv:not(.in)');
    toReveal.forEach(function(el){ io ? io.observe(el) : el.classList.add('in'); });
  }

  window.addEventListener('hashchange', go);
  go();

  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var open = nav.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  });

  document.getElementById('yr').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

  /* --- Right-click deterrent (per site owner's request). ---
     Note: this only discourages casual saving; it can't truly prevent
     downloads. Delete this block to re-enable the context menu. */
  document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); });
})();
</script>
